resources.string: Closes YouTube Shorts the moment they open.
Watches only the YouTube app. When the Shorts player opens it presses Back for you, and it can cover Shorts shelves in the feed. It reads nothing outside YouTube and sends nothing anywhere.
Not active. Turn on NoShorts blocker under Installed apps / Downloaded services.
Could not open that Settings screen on this device.
Presses Back as soon as a Short starts playing. If Back keeps landing in Shorts, it leaves YouTube instead.
Covers Shorts shelves with a black overlay. The feed still scrolls normally underneath. Needs the draw-over-apps permission.
Choose what happens when you open a youtube.com/shorts link. Use the button below to make NoShorts the default handler for those links.
Do not open it at all
If a YouTube update slips past the blocker, turn this on, open Shorts, then run: adb logcat -s NoShorts. Add the new ids to ShortsSignals.kt.
